note: FAILED spec: what a baseline-completion run that did not reach BASELINE_COMPLETION_ALL_DONE must still bring home. Only the session record is required, because a failure with no record is a failure nobody can diagnose. The comparison is best-effort here and required in the success spec: a run that failed before B was measured never wrote one, and demanding it would block teardown of a pod that is still billing. On lifecycle: the vocabulary is `final_required` and `mutable_snapshot` and nothing else -- `ArtifactSpec.__post_init__` refuses any other value, so an invented word makes this whole document UNLOADABLE and the collector exits 1 before it looks at a single file. `required: false` is what makes an artifact best-effort; `lifecycle` is what a matching file MEANS. Both C2 Search-1 specs said `best_effort` until 2026-09-16 and the failure surfaced during a teardown.
